title: Orfen
summary: Orfen is a release in Main / Live.
description:
Orfen is a release in Main / Live.

The base code means no more specific named part has been established; it is not a release number or priority.

Original technical catalog row: “Salvation: The Gathering / Orfen — объединённая строка источника”. The row names are preserved for provenance, not as globally established synonyms. Numbers refer to Game, not Login. This table does not establish regional release dates or packet formats. The official history separates The Gathering, Salvation Final: Etina’s Fate and Orfen. The association of 152 with Orfen additionally relies on L2-Scripts; it is not automatically extended to The Gathering or Etina’s Fate.

Regional date from the official history or patch notes: **KR, 2017-11-29**. This is not a client build date and does not establish a protocol number.
